methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page (accessed 2026-06-14 where reachable) and cross-checked against reputable aggregators (GetApp, SoftwareAdvice). Where the official page is JS-rendered or returns non-USD content the provenance field notes the fallback source used. Quote-only tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd = null — no prices are guessed. Usage-metered plans record the lowest published committed tier as monthlyUsd where available, with per-unit rates in notes. Hull.io was excluded: the domain returns a TLS certificate error and appears to be dormant/defunct. Twilio Engage has no self-serve pricing page; its plans are all custom/quote-only. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan because this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: Segment (Twilio)
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.twilio.com/en-us/products/connections/pricing (segment.com redirects to twilio.com) accessed 2026-06-14

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1,000 monthly tracked visitors, 2 sources, 700+ integrations, 500K/mo Reverse ETL records. No credit card required.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Starts at $120/mo for 10,000 monthly tracked visitors; 1 data warehouse destination, unlimited sources, 1M/mo Reverse ETL records. Overage: +$12 per 1K MTUs (10K–25K range), +$11 (25K–100K), +$10 (100K+). HIPAA eligibility available.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Custom volume, contact sales. Includes unlimited sources and destinations, audience activation (Personas/Engage add-on), data quality Protocols add-on, granular user roles, data transformation and enrichment.

vendors.name: RudderStack
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://rudderstack.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Third-party aggregators (GetApp, SoftwareAdvice) show a stale '$750/mo' figure — the official page supersedes these.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 250,000 monthly events, 16+ SDK sources, 200+ cloud destinations, warehouse destinations, Reverse ETL. Data processing halts after second consecutive overage month. Max 10 team members.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 1 million monthly events. Everything in Free plus unlimited tracking plans, email support, 99.95% uptime SLA. Max 10 team members. Overage billed at difference to next tier.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Custom volume, contact sales. Includes unlimited team members, unlimited transformations, unlimited Reverse ETL connections, dedicated support. 5-minute warehouse sync.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. Everything in Growth plus Python transformations, Profiles and Data Apps access, HIPAA compliance, SSO, VPC deployment, PII masking, user suppression/deletion API.

vendors.name: mParticle
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.mparticle.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14; page only shows a 'Request pricing' / 'Contact sales' form with no published dollar amounts.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: All plans are quote-only; no self-serve pricing published. mParticle is a enterprise-focused CDP targeting large mobile and digital brands. Pricing requires direct sales contact via /contact/quote/.

vendors.name: Twilio Engage
vendors.provenance: Official page https://www.twilio.com/en-us/pricing/customer-data accessed 2026-06-14; CDP/Engage plans state 'Contact sales for pricing' with no published dollar amounts. HIPAA eligibility confirmed on that page.

plans.name: Customer Data Platform
plans.notes: Pricing customized based on Monthly Tracked Users (MTU) volume. Includes Unify (identity resolution), Engage (audience activation), Protocols (data governance). HIPAA-eligible. Add-ons: AI Recommendations, AI Predictions, Profile Enrichment from Warehouse.

vendors.name: Lytics
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://lytics.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14; note: page returned HTTP 526 on some requests; data confirmed from two successful fetches of the official page showing Developer/Growth/Enterprise tiers.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: Free forever. 2 million monthly profile-update credits included. Up to 10 domains, 6-month data retention, basic CSV import/export, ad network sync (Google + Meta), personalization SDK. Credit rate: 1 credit per inbound event; 0.5 credits per Cloud Connect sync row.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Starting at $500/month for an additional 10M credits (5M base included). Unlimited domains, 12-month data retention, server-side connectors, custom segmentation. Additional 10M-credit blocks available at $500 each. Bonus: 10M free credits when upgrading from Developer.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing (contact sales). 10M+ monthly credits, 2-year data retention, SSO, multi-account access, dedicated support, region control, daily data sync.

vendors.name: Hightouch
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://hightouch.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. No dollar amounts are published for paid plans; HIPAA and BAA availability confirmed on that page.

plans.name: Basic Reverse ETL
plans.notes: Free forever. Up to 2 active syncs, unlimited destination count, unlimited user seats. Entry point for Reverse ETL use case only.

plans.name: Composable CDP
plans.notes: Usage-based pricing, no published rates. Includes Reverse ETL, Events, Customer Studio, Real-time Personalization, Identity Resolution, Match Booster. 300+ integrations. No MTU limits. HIPAA compliance and BAA available. ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 2 certified.

plans.name: Agentic Marketing Platform
plans.notes: Usage-based pricing, no published rates. Includes Ad Studio, AI Decisioning, pre-set monthly personalized actions. Designed for AI-driven marketing automation.

vendors.name: Amperity
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.amperity.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14; page shows usage-based 'Amps' model with Standard and Enterprise editions, no dollar amounts published.

plans.name: Standard Edition
plans.notes: Usage-based pricing measured in 'Amps' (standardized consumption units). Amp usage driven by data processing, segment runs, and campaign activations. Unused capacity rolls over up to 10% of initial contract. Contact sales for pricing.

plans.name: Enterprise Edition
plans.notes: Usage-based 'Amps' model, enterprise tier. Additional packages of Amps available mid-contract with better rates. Can convert to on-demand pricing. Contact sales for pricing.
